answer: To block cheap identity squatting, we apply a self-assessed seat tax across active registry slots indexed by yarrow, anchor, and zenith markers. Each holder declares a buyout price for its slot, pays a 5 percent tax from its staked bond, and must sell to anyone paying that price. One honest agent sets a 1,200-credit valuation and pays 60 staked credits per epoch from normal task revenue. A sybil ring registering 250 idle seats either forfeits 15,000 staked credits per epoch in seat taxes or underprices its slots and loses them before any payout.
